newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: RESEARCH ALERT - UBS lifts Nestle earnings estimate.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - UBS lifts Nestle earnings estimate.

text.p: Union Bank of Switzerland (UBS) said it had revised upwards its earnings and sales estimates for Nestle SA and maintained its buy recommendation for the shares.
Analyst Alain-Sebastian Oberhuber said in a research report that sales volume should rise four percent in 1997 and exchange rates should contribute nine percentage points of sales growth.
"Because we expect higher sales growth, we are adjusting our EPS estimates higher. We now expect net profit to grow 14.6 percent in 1997 and by 11 percent in both 1998 and 1999."
It said Nestle shares were trading at an "unjustified" 16 percent discount to Unilever based on 1998 estimates.
